blockingIssues.description: Harness execution marks missing comparator command templates as skipped instead of failing matrix completeness, allowing incomplete scenario/comparator coverage to pass.
Manifest validation does not enforce required comparator coverage per scenario and can report pass with missing rg/ugrep cells.
Claim gate does not enforce manifest-hash consistency across local/nightly/manual evidence sets, so mixed-manifest evidence can pass.
Threshold evaluation is effectively local-run-only and does not require threshold pass for nightly/manual runs, violating VAL-BENCH-012 requirements.
Sampling validator treats any present execution schedule as sufficient without enforcing declared interleaving/randomization semantics or seed integrity.
Measured harness command can exit success even when sampling validation fails, weakening policy gate enforcement.
Publication packaging only warns on missing required raw artifacts and continues, allowing incomplete bundles to be reported successful.
Checksum verifier does not enforce checksum-map coverage against manifest artifacts/required artifacts, allowing checksum-entry removal tampering to pass verification.
